children: USD.AI has scheduled a CHIP supply unlock for November 2027. The release will make at least 147.12 million CHIP available to investors and the team, equal to 7.36% of the circulating supply.
The unlock removes the restriction that kept recipients from selling those tokens. Investors and team members can then put some or all of that CHIP on the market, adding potential selling pressure.

title: USD.AI: At least 147.12 million CHIP unlocks for investors and team - Nov 2027
